title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Remote (North America/Latin America timezones)

Maximus ) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

Maximus is building an advanced telemedicine platform to help men improve their mental and physical health. We iterate on our product rapidly and safely by applying continuous integration and code quality measurements, as well as TDD and pair programming when appropriate. We work collaboratively, emphasizing the productivity of the team first. We aim to deliver a robust, reliable system by using pragmatic, tried-and-true technologies. We hone our craft as engineers by applying advanced functional, data-oriented techniques that are appropriate to the problem.

Please note: Culture is key at Maximus, so we get to know candidates holistically through our questionnaire. You will receive an invite in a separate email upon submitting an application. Please fill it out as honestly and intuitively as possible since it is designed to detect exaggeration, which will cause your application to be automatically rejected. The questionnaire is optional to submit now with your application, but candidates that do so will get strongly prioritized. Note, we do not have access to individual questions' answers/choices.

Responsibilities:

  • Write and ship high quality code. Contribute across the codebase to complete entire features and changes with support from the rest of the team. Continuously invest in demonstrable quality and reliability of the system via unit tests, automated integration tests, TDD and refactoring. Keep data management and security in mind at all times to protect customer privacy.

  • Contribute to a continuously improving engineering organization. Identify software quality, performance, and operational issues, including impediments to team-wide efficiency and work constructively with the team to address them. Define and improve our internal engineering standards and processes and exert positive influence on the objectives and tactics taken by the team.

  • Contribute actively to product iteration and development to ensure the company delivers a compelling experience to its customers. Generate ideas and assess the associated options and tradeoffs for how they impact the growth of the business and customer experience. Work across functional teams (engineering, marketing, product, etc.) to translate business and product ideas into software designs and releases. Product & Project Management skills and experience are a plus.

The ideal candidate will have the following:

Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in product software development, especially public consumer web applications

  • Front-end: React/Redux/ImmutableJS experience

  • Back-end: Ruby -on-Rails / Ruby experience, GCP, AWS, Postgres

    • Ruby experience is highly preferred

  • General experience in unit testing, integration testing.

  • Past experience or interest in pair programming.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with queue / background processing, 3rd party integrations (such as Stripe, or 3PL, etc.)

  • Familiarity with or interest in Event Sourcing and other immutability / functional-programming patterns.

  • TDD experience is a plus.

Qualities:

  • A dedication to keeping things simple and pragmatic.

  • Attitude of shared ownership of the system, frequent integration. Collaborates proactively, in service of the shared highest priority.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills: Proven ability to build strong relationships with technical and non-technical members of the team to solve challenging technical and business problems.

  • Relentlessly Resourceful ): highly proactive, does not quit, and finds innovative solutions with little guidance. Bias for action and ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Passion for Men's Health & Development: interest in helping men develop a healthy masculinity. Demonstrates personal dedication and interest in health optimization (e.g. diet, exercise, sleep, focus, and relationships).

World-Class Benefits:

  • Best-in-class 401K options

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies

  • Liquidity of options whenever available

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled QA Manual & Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our web and/or enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in manual testing, along with hands-on expertise in test automation frameworks, and will work closely with development, product, and DevOps teams.
Key Responsibilities
Manual Testing
Analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to create detailed test cases and test scenarios
Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and UAT testing
Execute manual test cases and document results clearly
Identify, log, track, and retest defects using tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar
Participate in requirement reviews and provide testability feedback
Ensure test coverage and maintain test documentation
Automation Testing
Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web and/or API applications
Work with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, or similar
Automate regression and smoke test suites
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.)
Analyze automation results and report failures clearly
Maintain and enhance automation frameworks
Collaboration & Quality Ownership
Work closely with developers, product owners, and Scrum teams in an Agile/Scrum environment
Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives
Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and best practices
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
Strong knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
Solid experience in manual testing of web applications
Hands-on experience with automation testing frameworks
Experience testing REST APIs using tools like Postman or Rest Assured
Knowledge of SQL for data validation
Familiarity with version control systems (Git)
Experience working in Agile environments
Nice to Have
Experience with performance testing (JMeter, LoadRunner)
Experience with mobile testing
Knowledge of BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
ISTQB or similar QA certification
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills (English required; Spanish a plus)

Ability to work independently and in a team environment

title: Projetista de Ativações de Marca
description:
Sobre a HIKE

A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira e transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.

Sobre a Vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar o briefing e a VT em projetos cenográficos criativos, viáveis e alinhados aos guides de marca. Na prática, é quem equilibra conceito de marca, arquitetura e execução propondo soluções inteligentes de layout, volumetria e materiais, detalhando com rigor técnico, compatibilizando marcenaria/serralheria/elétrica e garantindo que tudo o que é desenvolvido seja exequível, seguro e com padrão high-end.

Nível do Cargo

Sênior

Localidade:

Rio de Janeiro (RJ)

Principais Responsabilidades

Tradução criativa de briefing e VT:

Interpretar briefing, dados da VT e guides de marca, convertendo necessidades em soluções cenográficas com identidade, coerência estética e viabilidade construtiva.

Conceito espacial e solução criativa:

Propor ideias de layout, volumetria, fluxos, pontos de destaque e materiais que elevem a experiência e reforcem a experiência da marca, considerando restrições reais (prazo, custo, montagem, ambiente, etc).

Estudos preliminares:

Desenvolver estudos iniciais (layout, volumetria e alternativas) com rapidez e repertório, apresentando opções e racional de escolha.

Anteprojeto:

Construir anteprojetos com definições de implantação, medidas, linguagem de materiais e lógica construtiva 3D, garantindo base sólida para orçamento e validação.

Projeto executivo e detalhamento:

Produzir projetos executivos completos (plantas, cortes, elevações e detalhamento técnico), com clareza de montagem e precisão para produção.

Especificação de materiais:

Especificar materiais, acabamentos e ferragens equilibrando estética, disponibilidade, custo, durabilidade e padrão high-end.

Normas e segurança:

Aplicar normas técnicas e boas práticas de segurança/estabilidade, assegurando que a solução seja segura, montável e adequada ao ambiente.

Visitas técnicas e validação em campo:

Realizar visitas técnicas aos locais de instalação para levantamento de medidas, identificação de restrições, validação de premissas de projeto e alinhamento com produção e operação.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como projetista em projetos espaciais (cenografia, live marketing, arquitetura efêmera, ativações de marca ou similares).

  • Capacidade de propor soluções criativas de espaço (layout, volumetria, materiais) sem perder viabilidade e segurança.

  • Domínio de desenho técnico e detalhamento executivo (plantas, cortes, elevações e especificações).

  • Conhecimento de materiais e processos construtivos, com olhar para acabamento e padrão high-end.

  • Boa comunicação e postura colaborativa para interface com GP, produção e fornecedores.

  • Domínio de ferramentas de projeto (Autodesk 3ds Max será um diferencial).

  • Disponibilidade para viagens e realização de visitas técnicas conforme demanda dos projetos.

Diferencial:

Experiência em projetos de tailor-made para PDVs de marcas da indústria de bebidas.

title: Analista de Comunicação
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:
A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.
DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:
O Analista de Comunicação terá a responsabilidade de oferecer suporte abrangente em todas as áreas relacionadas a comunicação da Filial do Rio de Janeiro. Isso inclui redação de conteúdos de divulgação, elaboração de apresentações institucionais e de projetos, cobertura audiovisual de atividades com captação e edição de imagens e vídeos editados com e sem depoimento, criação de plano de comunicação e marketing dos projetos junto aos financiadores, elaboração de materiais de marketing dos projetos. É importante ter habilidade em planejamento e gerenciamento de campanhas de comunicação e marketing.
PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:
Apoiar na criação e elaboração de apresentações e portifólio de projetos para stakeholders e patrocinadores.
Colaborar ativamente na divulgação de projetos em andamento e no registro detalhado das atividades desenvolvidas.
Criar e propor materiais de comunicação em linha com as diretrizes de Comunicação da AVSI Brasil e financiadores.
Auxiliar na criação de materiais gráficos dos projetos.
Realizar a cobertura audiovisual das atividades dos projetos com captação e edição de imagens e vídeos editados com e sem depoimentos.

title: Analista de Consumer Insights Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga
Com uma trajetória de mais de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.
Nossas +1300 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.
A área de Consumer Insights na área de Clientes tem como missão compreender profundamente os clientes e transformar esses conhecimentos em ações estratégicas para o negócio. Ela combina dados de pesquisa de mercado, comportamento de consumo e informações de CRM para criar uma visão completa do cliente, apoiar decisões de marketing, fidelização, comunicação e experiência, e antecipar tendências de consumo. O foco é gerar insights que conectem comportamento do cliente a estratégias de negócio, garantindo que campanhas, ofertas e ações sejam relevantes, personalizadas e eficazes
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:
Atuar em projetos de pesquisa de forma completa, desde a definição de objetivos e metodologia até a entrega de insights e recomendações estratégicas;
Configurar e gerenciar pesquisas em plataformas proprietárias e de parceiros externos, assegurando que sejam utilizadas de acordo com os objetivos de cada estudo;
Colaborar com equipes internas e parceiros externos na coleta e análise de dados;
Desenvolver relatórios e apresentações claros e objetivos, comunicando resultados e insights que contribuam para tomada de ação e decisões;
Contribuir de forma ativa em discussões estratégicas, oferecendo uma visão informada sobre estudos e insights de pesquisas realizadas;
Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências e metodologias de pesquisa, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas de mercado;
Requisitos e qualificações
O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:
Graduação completa em marketing, administração, engenharias e áreas correlatas;
Ampla experiência em funções de pesquisa de mercado, com habilidade em análise e interpretação de dados e aplicação de insights;
Domínio de metodologias quantitativas (como pesquisas online, NPS, clusterização, segmentação) e qualitativas (entrevistas em profundidade, focus group);
Conhecimento em SQL, BigQuery e Looker;
Capacidade de comunicação (escrita e verbal), organização pessoal e de processos;
Domínio de Pacote Office, (principalmente Excel e Powerpoint).
Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

title: Auxiliar de Atendimento Logístico
description:
A Stone
Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.
Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.
Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.
Nossa Cultura
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
O Time De Logística
A Logística é um ponto-chave na nossa missão de encantar o(a) cliente. Afinal, para atingir o objetivo de transformar o mercado de meios de pagamento, é preciso pensar em cada detalhe.
Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Para atingir esse objetivo, nossa área é responsável por atuar em toda cadeia logística (Supply, Sistemas, Last Mile, Gente e Segurança), colocando a mão na massa desde as compras das maquininhas até a sua efetiva entrega para nossos(as) clientes.
Conheça um pouco mais do time de Logística no Nosso Manifesto.
Como é ser um(a) Auxiliar de Atendimento Logístico | GREEN ANGEL (Moto):
Conhecido como Green Angels, esse time tem a missão de realizar o atendimento do(a) nosso(a) cliente diretamente em seu ponto de venda.
A sua atividade principal é atender nossos(as) usuários(as) de maneira externa, tanto dentro da cidade como nas regiões de abrangência, ajudando-os na inicialização e utilização correta dos produtos que contratou conosco.
Além disso, você também será o responsável pelas atividades realizadas no polo onde irá atuar, realizando a gestão do estoque, recebimento de ativos, logística reversa, triagem dos equipamentos, organização e inventários periódicos do estoque.
Conheça um pouco mais do(a) Green Angel aqui.
O Que Esperamos De Você
CNH A ou AB (Moto) ativa por pelo menos 2 anos;
Ter menos 10 pontos ativos na CNH nos últimos 12 meses;
Ensino Médio completo.
O Que Aumenta As Suas Chances
Ter concluído ou estar cursando Técnico ou Ensino Superior em Ciências Sociais Aplicadas (Logística, Administração, e afins);
Experiência com atendimento ao cliente;
Experiência com Logística.
Excel intermediário/avançado.
Jornada De Trabalho
CLT: 44 horas semanais com, no mínimo, 1h de intervalo diário | Escala: 6x1 ( Segunda-feira a Sábado) | com atendimento aos estabelecimentos que estejam abertos das 13h ás 22h.
#Segurança - Para garantir a nossa segurança e a de terceiros, trabalhamos seguindo à risca as regras e leis de trânsito, falamos no mínimo duas vezes por semana sobre segurança e analisamos indicadores que nos orientam a mapear ocorrências e fazer melhorias na operação.

title: Analista de Atendimento Técnico Júnior
description:
Descrição da vaga

O time atua garantindo que incidentes automatizados sejam corretamente direcionados e tratados, evitando gargalos operacionais e falhas repetitivas no processo. Um exemplo é o fluxo SAP, Nota Fiscal, Rejeição ou Erro, que envolve integrações críticas para funcionamento do negócio. Essa atuação reduz retrabalho, acelera resolução de falhas recorrentes e mantém a logística operando com confiabilidade ,essencial para cumprimento de prazos comerciais e experiência do cliente.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:
Atender e registrar chamados técnicos via Freshservice, seguindo SLAs e fluxos definidos;
Realizar suporte N1 aos sistemas legados (Oracle) e ao novo ambiente SAP;
Executar análises iniciais de incidentes e requisições (triagem, diagnóstico básico e evidências);
Acompanhar e monitorar serviços, aplicações e APIs via Datadog;
Validar falhas técnicas, indisponibilidades e degradações de performance;
Realizar consultas em banco de dados para apoio ao diagnóstico (leitura e escrita controlada);
Acionar corretamente times de N2/N3 (desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, banco de dados, integrações).
Registrar histórico técnico e evidências nos chamados;
Apoiar áreas operacionais (CDs, logística, operação digital) em incidentes do dia a dia;
Seguir processos de ITIL (incidente, requisição, problema, mudança – nível básico).
Requisitos e qualificações
O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:
Conhecimento em e-commerce e logística (pedido, picking, packing, expedição, SLA e integrações);
Noções de ERP, com foco em SAP (suporte funcional/técnico N1);
Experiência em ambientes legados Oracle;
Conhecimento em Oracle Database e SQL básico (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY);
Interpretação de dados para apoio às atividades de suporte;
Noções de bancos de dados não relacionais, com conhecimento conceitual em MongoDB;
Conhecimento em monitoramento de aplicações e infraestrutura;
Experiência com Datadog para visualização de métricas, análise de alertas e identificação inicial de falhas;
Experiência com ferramentas de ITSM (ex.: Freshservice), incluindo abertura, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados;
Classificação de impacto e prioridade e comunicação clara com usuários e times técnicos.
Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:
Noções de APIs REST (HTTP, JSON, métodos GET/POST);
Conhecimento básico para leitura de payloads e logs de integração;
Noções conceituais de Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
Conhecimento básico em containers (Docker);
Noções de fundamentos de redes (DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, latência);
Conhecimento dos fundamentos de ITIL;
Noções de gestão de incidentes e problemas;
Vivência em ambientes de operação 24x7.

title: assistant marketing manager
description:
Company Description

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

THE HOTEL

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026.

Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand's contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.

Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.

Job Description

THE POSITION

The Assistant Marketing Manager - Social Media, Brand & Content supports the hotel's digital presence and brand strategy, managing content and campaigns across social media, websites, OTAs, and CRM platforms. This role plays a key part in shaping the hotel's digital identity, creating engaging content, and supporting the launch of new or renovated properties. The position ensures consistent messaging, guest engagement, and alignment with revenue and brand objectives.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the digital and social media strategy for a new luxury hotel brand, shaping its presence from pre-opening through ongoing operations to express a refined, aspirational, and globally recognized brand identity;
  • Create, curate, and oversee compelling content across social media, digital platforms, and multimedia campaigns, highlighting the hotel's unique services, experiences, and lifestyle;
  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across Rooms, F&B, MICE, Spa, and other offerings to drive engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth;
  • Manage pre-opening initiatives, including website setup, social media launch, and digital campaigns, to generate interest and anticipation ahead of the brand's debut;
  • Monitor digital performance, analyze engagement metrics, and optimize content and campaigns to maximize visibility, interaction, and business results;
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, revenue, and operations teams to ensure integrated strategies, consistent brand messaging, and high-end guest experiences;
  • Maintain a strong brand voice and identity across all digital channels, ensuring storytelling aligns with the hotel's global positioning;
  • Monitor social media trends, digital innovations, and best practices in luxury hospitality marketing to enhance the brand's digital presence/
  • Prepare regular reports on digital performance, KPIs, and campaign results, providing actionable insights to inform strategy and decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or related field;
  • Proven experience in social media management, digital content creation and brand marketing, preferably in luxury hospitality;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. French is a plus;
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and project coordination skills;
  • Deep knowledge of current digital marketing concepts, trends, and innovations, with the ability to apply them strategically to elevate the brand's presence.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, social media management tools, and content creation platforms;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Job Category: Sales & Marketing

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.
Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior SDET Engineer to build and scale automation foundations that directly ensure product reliability and high-quality releases. In this role, you'll lead automation strategy across web, API, and microservices, combining Java-driven engineering, CI/CD integration, and modern testing practices to influence how quality is built from day one. This opportunity stands out for its strong technical ownership, leadership impact, and the chance to shape a true quality-first culture across squads.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Build and maintain scalable, robust automation frameworks from the ground up for both Web and API layers;
Define the automation strategy, ensuring high test coverage and reliable release cycles within squads;
Create comprehensive API automation suites to ensure the integrity of microservices;
Implement and manage frontend automation scripts to ensure a top-tier user experience;
Mentor other engineers on testing best practices and foster a quality-first culture.
MUST HAVES
4+ years of experience as an SDET Engineer ;
Strong programming skills in Java with a developer-first approach to QA;
Extensive experience using REST Assured for API automation;
Proven hands-on experience with Playwright for frontend automation;
Deep understanding of the shift-left approach and integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines ;
Ability to work independently and provide technical direction on quality initiatives;
Upper-intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
Previous experience in Loyalty or Fintech domains;
Experience with performance or load testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling ;
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and SQL for data validation within test scripts;
Experience working with mocking frameworks.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

title: Intern/Mechanical Engineer
description:
ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS's core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. 

What You Will Do:

  • The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
    • Engineering Plan Review.
    • Technical Plan Review.
    • Research and Product Development.
    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
    • Data Science and Digital Services
  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
  • Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
  • May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
  • May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Applicants must be working towards an engineering degree at an accredited school and have completed 50 semester hours towards that degree before the start of the internship.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Basic engineering knowledge and proficiency in Excel and AutoCAD are preferred.
  • Must be a full-time student currently enrolled in an accredited university and pursuing a BS, MS, or Ph.D. degree in one of the following engineering discipline:
    • Mechanical Engineering 

Reporting Relationships:

This position does not have any direct reports.

title: GSD) Workday Functional Specialist/Senior Specialist
description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know our Team:
The Global Service Delivery (GSD) team is responsible for Agoda's office infrastructure and staff connectivity. We provide the hardware, software, and access to resources that allows staff to achieve their goals. We operate in 10 different countries, providing 24/7 support to all Agoda employees. Whether in the office, working remotely, or traveling, we enable everyone to stay connected. The GSD team uses state-of-the-art cloud management technologies combined with the best of on-site services to manage the latest hardware running Windows, macOS, and Linux.
The Opportunity:
As a Workday Specialist - Benefits, you'll be the go-to expert ensuring our Workday platform runs seamlessly and continues to evolve with the business. You'll take the lead on all things Benefits, while also strengthening our foundation across HCM, Security, and Reporting.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who loves diving deep into system design and data but also enjoys seeing the bigger picture - how technology can simplify work, enhance employee experience, and drive better decisions. You'll partner closely with People and IT teams to deliver scalable solutions, optimize existing processes, and explore new ways Workday and other tools can bring value to the organization.
If you're someone who enjoys solving complex problems, thrives in a collaborative environment, and is eager to expand your skills beyond Workday, this role will give you the platform to do just that.
This role will be based in Bangkok and relocation will be provided.
In this Role, you'll get to:
Serve as the Workday Benefits Specialist, leading the design, configuration, and maintenance of core benefits processes, eligibility rules, plans, and programs.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable Workday solutions that enhance employee experience.
Participate in testing cycles, release readiness activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to maximize Workday capabilities.
Own and manage reporting, calculated fields, and security configurations related to Benefits, ensuring data integrity and appropriate access levels.
Gain opportunities to work across other Workday domains and internal tools, expanding expertise based on project needs and personal interests.
Stay informed on new Workday releases and people technology trends, identifying opportunities for enhancement and automation.
Explore and contribute to other internal tools and technologies beyond Workday, expanding your technical footprint within the People Technology ecosystem.
What you'll Need to Succeed:
4 - 6 years of hands-on Workday experience, with at least 2–3 years focused on Benefits configuration and reporting
Deep expertise in Core Benefits setup including eligibility rules, enrollment events, and integrations with benefit providers.
Strong proficiency in Advanced Reporting and Calculated Fields, with the ability to build complex, cross-domain reports.
Solid understanding of HCM fundamentals, covering both business processes (Hire, Change Job, Termination) and configuration concepts (condition rules, orgs, hierarchies, custom objects)
Working knowledge of Workday Security, including constrained/unconstrained roles and segmented security
Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for process efficiency and data integrity.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and translate business needs into system design.
Bachelor's degree in HR, IT, Business Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
It's Great if you have:
Experience with Workday Open Enrollment or global benefits rollouts
Exposure to Workday integrations (EIBs) related to benefits or payroll.
Experience working in an international or fast-paced environment.
Workday certification(s) in HCM or Benefits
Interest in expanding knowledge beyond Workday into other people technology platforms and tools.
What you'll get:
Medical, dental, mental health support line, annual leave, travel discounts, sick days, and the AgodaChoice flexible spending benefit
Provident fund benefits, and life insurance
Flexibility to help you work in the way that's best for you with a work from home allowance, 30-day work from anywhere benefit, and hybrid working options.
Unlimited online learning access, several in-person development programs for each stage of your career, and career paths for management and individual contributors
The chance to live in Bangkok, one of the best cities in Southeast Asia and a central hub for travel. Within 3 hours you can hit any of the most popular countries like Vietnam, Singapore, Laos, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, just to name a few.
A generous relocation package to help you get here comfortably.

Job Description
Sobre a vaga
Na M. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem

Quem somos
Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura
Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Missão Do Cargo
Coordenar o desenvolvimento e implementação de campanhas para equipe de vendas e merchandising e ações promocionais que alcancem os consumidores no ponto de venda, maximizando vendas

Responsibilities and assignments

Seus Desafios Serão

  • Coordenar a equipe de Supervisores/Líderes de Trade, desenvolvendo e orientando a equipe em suas atribuições;
  • Desenvolver e implementar projetos de execução no PDV com base nas estratégias das áreas envolvidas;
  • Analisar o faseamento sugerido pelos parceiros para implementação das ações de trade marketing;
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais das ações de trade marketing para prestação de contas junto à Gerência de Trade e Comerciais.
  • Estruturar as recomendações de exposição em loja, considerando os diferentes cenários de ponto de venda;
  • Controlar o fluxo da execução de todas as ações junto ao time de trade marketing;
  • Analisar e controlar o orçamento das áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Visitar sua área de atuação para garantir desenvolvimento do time, orientando nas demandas e realização das atividades relacionadas aos projetos do setor;
  • Desenvolver treinamentos para capacitação do time de merchandising;
  • Cumprir os requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Superior completo;
  • Desejável pós-graduação em áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, Power Point, e BI;
  • No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.

  • Canais de distribuição;

Estamos em busca de universitários que estejam cursando licenciatura em Ciências Biológicas comprometidos com a excelência acadêmica e o desenvolvimento integral dos alunos.

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará em nosso radar para futuras oportunidades em nossas unidades. Se você tem brilho nos olhos, gosta de desafios e quer atuar em uma rede que cresce e transforma vidas, venha construir essa jornada com a gente

  • Suporte aos alunos do Ensino Fundamental Anos Finais, Ensino Médio e Militares.
  • Atuar com foco na excelência acadêmica, contribuindo para uma cultura de aprendizado consistente e de alto desempenho;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos alunos, identificando oportunidades de reforço, orientação e incentivo ao aprendizado;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas, momentos de formação e eventos institucionais;
  • Colaborar com os colegas, fortalecendo um ambiente escolar positivo, de troca e cooperação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Licenciatura em andamento em História— a vaga é destinada exclusivamente a estudantes, não sendo válida para candidatos já formados;

Informações adicionais

Esta vaga contempla as unidades localizadas na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana.

Aqui no Elite, valorizamos e incentivamos a diversidade. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade, origem, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica. Acreditamos que times diversos constroem uma educação ainda mais transformadora.

Presentes em Belo Horizonte, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro, há 20 anos, somos a escola responsável por transformar vidas por meio da educação. Somos uma família de colaboradores que acredita na educação como a melhor maneira de formar crianças e jovens vencedores, capazes de conquistar seu próprio sucesso, no campo em que desejarem. Com os nossos mais de 27 mil alunos e familiares, formamos uma família ainda maior e com valores fortes, vividos a todo momento em cada uma das nossas escolas – AMOR, GARRA, FOCO e MÉRITO.

Para alcançarmos o nosso objetivo, contamos com um time apaixonado pelo poder transformador da educação e que entende o que é ser escola hoje, se preocupando, em primeiro lugar, com os alunos. Aqui você vai encontrar:

AMOR

Somos movidos pelo amor. A vitória de cada aluno é a vitória de todos: escola, aluno e família.

GARRA

Lutamos com persistência, todos os dias e até o fim, para que o nosso aluno possa ir além. Sabemos que é o esforço dele que o faz crescer.

FOCO

Sabemos aonde queremos chegar e temos determinação e disciplina para chegar lá.

MÉRITO

Valorizamos cada um conforme seu esforço e resultado. Vitória e mérito andam sempre juntos.

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, o seu lugar é no Elite.

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, em 2024 a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Gas Insulated Switchgear Specialist Engineer
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted.
***English proficiency (written and spoken) required. Submit CV in English for consideration***
Overview:
We are seeking a Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) Specialist to join the Technical Services Division. The Technical Services Division is responsible for providing and managing highly technical and specialized engineering services to support the safe and reliable operation of Saudi Aramco's electrical transmission and distribution networks. Your primary role is to provide specialized technical support in regards to designs, standards, commissioning, maintenance, operation, investigation in order to ensure safe and reliable Power Supply.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Perform root cause analysis on critical equipment failures to determine the underlying causes and recommend corrective actions.
Assess maintenance programs for high voltage equipment to identify areas for improvement and ensure safe and reliable operation of these assets.
Provide technical expertise to support maintenance of existing equipment, including reviewing spare parts lists and troubleshooting failures.
Provides technical consultation to assess the condition of aging switchgears and breakers including the use of new innovative technologies.
Offer technical guidance on repairs and evaluate whether equipment is designed to meet its intended service conditions.
Provide engineering input on repair details and offer onsite technical support for critical equipment.
Ensure that work packages are designed to meet the company's standards and material specifications.
Review company standards and stay up-to-date with international standards to ensure compliance and best practices.
Provide technical training and guidance to stakeholders as needed to support the safe and reliable operation of high voltage equipment.
Provide technical design level insight of GIS technology, with a minimum voltage level of 69 kilovolts and higher.
Demonstrate an active role in the commissioning of GIS, either as part of a project team or as an original equipment manufacturer.
Assess and ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, such as those set by the IEC, during factory acceptance testing, and demonstrate a deep understanding of these standards.
Assimilate and quickly apply newly acquired technical information to stay up-to-date with the latest developments in GIS technology.
Minimum Requirements:
As a successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus.
You will have a Minimum of 10 years of operations and maintenance experience directly working with GIS.
You will have In-depth knowledge, experience, and recognition as a GIS specialist include membership of international engineering bodies and contribution at international conferences.
A background in the oil and gas, utility, or equipment manufacturers is plus.
Professional Engineering certifications such as chartership or PE is preferred.

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
Would you thrive in a role where welding excellence, technical rigor and cross‑functional collaboration ensure flawless execution of fabrication processes?

Would you bring the discipline, expertise and problem‑solving mindset needed to drive continuous improvement and compliance in welding operations?

Join our Quality Team

At Baker Hughes, Quality is essential to delivering safe, reliable and high-performing products. Our Product QA team ensures alignment with the Quality Management System (QMS), customer requirements and industry standards across welding, fabrication and validation processes.

Partner with the best

As a Quality Engineer, Product QA (Welding Discipline), you will ensure that welding processes, consumables, qualifications and inspection requirements are properly implemented, validated and monitored across internal operations and suppliers. You will collaborate closely with engineering, materials, NDE specialists and customer representatives to guarantee flawless execution.

As the Quality Engineer, Product QA (Welding Discipline) you will be responsible for:

  • Supporting product engineering in identifying, reviewing and implementing welding requirements.
  • Developing project welding matrices aligned with the Materials Engineering team.
  • Qualifying welding processes in‑house and reviewing supplier welding qualification processes.
  • Recording welding qualifications properly through PQRs and WPS documentation.
  • Reviewing and approving local welding work instructions.
  • Implementing and controlling best practices for welding consumables, including required approvals per applicable industry codes.
  • Overseeing welding operations in‑house and at suppliers according to ABNT NBR 14842 responsibilities.
  • Witnessing laboratory tests for welding and welder qualifications and reporting results.
  • Controlling welder qualification records and monitoring performance per relevant standards.
  • Deploying continuous improvement actions in welding operations based on product performance.
  • Supporting Project Quality teams with welding expertise across live projects.
  • Interfacing with customer welding SMEs during project execution.
  • Identifying and escalating critical observations and concerns across the organization.
  • Running product quality audits and performing Gemba walks to verify project requirements flow-down.
  • Supporting and/or leading Go/No-Go reviews and facilitating pre-production meetings.
  • Capturing, resolving and communicating welding Lessons Learned to product delivery and supply teams.
  • Ensuring welding non‑conformances are properly identified and recorded by the responsible fabrication contacts.
  • Witnessing product inspections and qualification activities as per inspection and test plans.
  • Reviewing and approving supplier welding quality records.
  • Communicating with colleagues regarding approaches and methods for solving complex welding issues.
  • Adhering to Product Line directives for standard quality requirements at fabrication sites.
  • Contributing to root‑cause analyses for welding non‑conformances and issues.
  • Supporting the Quality team in evaluating NDE inspection applicability and improvements in‑house or at suppliers.
  • Reviewing and approving weld maps.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Welding, Materials or Production Engineering.
  • Have fluent English skills.
  • Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements for subsea fabrication (XT, Manifolds, Tooling).
  • Have strong and proven experience in welding discipline for subsea equipment.
  • Have experience performing quality audits to support customer project assessments.
  • Have knowledge in product quality inspection and documentation analysis.
  • Have experience interacting with customers and inspection bodies.
  • Have knowledge of NDE inspections (MP, DP, UT, PAUT, etc).
  • Have knowledge of common Oil & Gas materials.
  • Have Welding Inspector Qualification (FBTS Level 2).
  • Have strong oral and written communication skills. (Desired)

title: Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing
description:
Airswift is looking for a Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing (Hybrid and Offshore)
to work on a 12-month assignment in Rio de Janeiro with a major oil and gas company.
The Professional will provide specialized technical support in deepwater exploration and appraisal well testing to the well team in Brazil. The Senior Well Testing Technical Specialist will be responsible for technical design, detailed engineering, and operational supervision activities in the field to safely and reliably design, plan, and execute E&A well testing scopes in Brazil, in compliance with all local regulations and relevant company and industry standards. The professional will work with a multidisciplinary and international team to ensure the safe delivery of all technical and commercial objectives for the complex and challenging deepwater E&A well testing scopes. This will include, among other activities, addressing process safety and operational risks, providing reliable technical engineering designs, developing detailed operational procedures, and providing supervision and monitoring of offshore operations at the well site.
Job Responsibilities
In this role the Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing will:
Work as part of a team, under the direction of the Well Discipline Lead and Regional Wells Superintendent
Promote a strong safety culture across all well testing activities, focusing on inherently safer designs, process safety, procedural discipline, adherence to standards and collaboration with key stakeholders
Manage and work collaboratively with well testing and drilling teams and associated contractors to develop safe and reliable designs and robust and detailed operational procedures.
Lead and coordinate management of regional resources and activity with direct input from regional and functional management and engineering teams.
Oversight of contractual and technical conformance of the service providers and ensuring time and cost budgets are accurately forecasted and spending is appropriately monitored and controlled.
Review operational failure incidents, analyse root cause effects and present findings to ensure a positive learning culture.
Write deep technical reports, basis of designs, well programmes, work instructions and other documentation in English and be computer literate with relevant office and technical software packages
Manage and support HAZard IDentification, HAZard OPerability studies and Layers Of Protection Analysis, HSE risk assessments, well operations reviews, certification and design engineering reviews.
Integrate service providers and client demands to deliver safe, efficient and compliant operations.
Interface with the rig personnel on preparation of SIMOPS, TWOPs and safety critical and operational procedures.
Provide onshore logistical and operational support for regional activity as required.
Report directly to and provide technical support and safety advice to the Well Site Leaders during offshore execution
Lead and supervise site based Well Testing and related operations as required; ensuring systems are installed, commissioned and operated as per approved design and programme.
Provide quality control and quality assurance for all the well test and fluid data acquisition activities at site.
Perform end of well reporting and financial reconciliation, capturing lessons learnt and driving continuous improvement plans and initiatives.
Job Qualifications
Experience in deepwater well testing, including experience in operators and the service sector in the design, planning, and direct supervision of deepwater exploration and appraisal (E&A) well testing operations. Prior experience in process safety, including HAZIDs, HAZOPs, and LOPAs, and their application in improving the safety and reliability of well testing operations. Prior experience in design assurance and supervision of safety systems and critical safety equipment for deepwater, subsea, and surface well testing.
Bachelor's degree required.
Advanced English - Required.
Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF).
BOSIET or HUET training applicable for locations requiring helicopter transport to the well.
About Airswift
Airswift serves as a strategic partner to our clients in STEM industries. We offer a turnkey workforce solution to acquire, mobilise and employ top talent in over 70 countries. With 800 employees in over 60 offices worldwide, 7,000 contractors and a candidate database of 1.5m specialists, our geographical reach and pool of available talent, experience and expertise is unmatched in the industry. We are proud to serve as a trusted advisor to clients looking to expand their operations internationally and offer employer of record services, payroll outsourcing, as well as HR consulting.

HSE AND COMPLIANCE – THE SERVICE HOLDER SHALL:
Fully comply with site security, health, and safety requirements and maintain continuous hazard awareness
Demonstrate exemplary H3SE behaviour, complete required training, and follow CPY Subsea HSE Lead directives
Report issues/anomalies through site systems and apply STOP WORK when necessary
Ensure risk assessments and toolbox talks are performed effectively
Comply with Company Ethics and Code of Conduct, supporting Anti-Corruption initiatives
WORK TASKS
The Service Holder will ensure that work performed by CTR and sub-contractors complies with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations. Responsibilities include:
Conduct inspection of welds and welding processes in accordance with WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications
Perform inspections before, during, and after welding per ISO requirements
Apply extensive inspection experience (minimum 10 years) with CRA materials: Super Duplex (Pipe/Forging/HIPPED), Inconel 625, and LAS (F22)
Inspect buttering, overlay, and girth welding using Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables
Perform advanced NDT methods:
Visual
Ultrasonic
PAUT (Phased Array UT)
Magnetic Particle
Liquid Penetrant
Verify testing in accordance with ASME and DNV requirements
Review WPS and PQR to validate production compliance
Inspect incoming materials against specifications and mill certificates
Participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and implement corrective actions
Identify and report deviations or quality issues impacting SPS equipment
Prepare weekly inspection reports
Coordinate with Company Site Representative and CPY Material Engineer on welding, NDT, and materials matters
Stop work in case of non-conformity and reassess prior to restart
Agree practical solutions with contractors that maintain quality without impacting schedule
Ensure timely closure of non-conformities
Monitor site welding activities and provide feedback to the project team
Participate in audits and follow up on corrective actions
CONTEXT & ENVIRONMENT
The service supports the execution phase of a major offshore development project. The multidisciplinary project team manages subsea systems, FPSO integration, and reservoir development.
Project objectives include:
Maximising economic performance
Optimising schedule, cost, and emissions
Maintaining high technical quality and H3SE standards
DURATION / LOCATION
Start Date: 1 March 2026
Duration: 1 year (renewable through fabrication until mid-2028)
Location: Rio, Brazil, with frequent travel to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG
Status: Residential
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
Experience with WAG Manifolds and subsea structures
15+ years of welding inspection experience
Certification as Welding Inspector: CWI / CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent)
NDT Level 3 certification (UT & PAUT, RT, DPI)
Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Fluent English required (Portuguese and/or French an advantage)

The Manager, Finance & Compliance provides financial stewardship and ensures regulatory compliance for all Physical Facilities Management (PFM) operations. Expertise in budget management, financial reporting, and compliance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Effective communication and collaboration skills.
Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams, service providers, and complex budgets.
Ability to develop long-term strategies that balance financial sustainability with operational excellence.
Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills with focus on accountability and innovation.
Commitment to service quality, timeliness, and the University's mission.

title: UGC Coordinators
description:
We are inBeat, a leading creative growth agency that partners with world-class brands like Bumble, Miro, and Nordstrom. We blend data-driven paid media with authentic influencer and User-Generated Content (UGC) marketing to deliver measurable results.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced UGC Creator Manager to join our remote team. Our business is growing rapidly, and we need an expert who can help us scale our network of high-performing UGC creators.

This is not just about finding people to make videos. We need a strategic operator who understands the creator economy inside and out. You will be responsible for the entire creator pipeline: from sourcing and vetting niche talent to negotiating rates and managing relationships to ensure a steady flow of top-quality, on-brand content for our clients.

Your Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Proactively sourcing and recruiting high-quality UGC creators across various platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.).

  • Building and maintaining a meticulously organized database of vetted creators, tagged by niche, skills, and performance history.

  • Managing the end-to-end casting process for client campaigns, including briefing creators and ensuring content aligns with brand guidelines.

  • Negotiating rates and usage rights with creators to ensure fair compensation and clear deliverables.

  • Developing and implementing innovative strategies for finding "hard-to-cast" creators in niche demographics.

  • Collaborating with our internal team of creative strategists and project managers.

Who We're Looking For:

  • You have a proven track record (2+ years) as a UGC Manager, Influencer Coordinator, or Talent Manager, preferably in an agency setting.

  • You are a master sourcer who knows how to find authentic creators that aren't on every other brand's roster.

  • You are a savvy negotiator who can secure great rates and build long-term partnerships.

  • You are obsessively organized and comfortable using tools like Airtable, Notion, or other CRMs to manage a large volume of talent.

  • You have a keen eye for what makes content compelling and perform well on social media.

title: Control Room Operator
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Production Supervisor

    • Background


  • A CRO is capable of operating DCS, Fire and Gas and ESD systems from Central Control Room. They will optimize the process and reduce and control plant upsets. They will respond effectively to emergencies. They will ensure that plant inhibits, and overrides are controlled as per procedures and Management System guidelines. They will ensure that that personnel under his supervision are fully competent and aware of their responsibilities.

    • Authority


  • The CRO is authorized to control and adjust the automated process safely to maximize production efficiency, and to coordinate permits and related isolations for maintenance.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Lead Production Technician, Production Technicians, Subcontractors, Vendors, Visitors.

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Process
  • 1 Start up, Operate, Monitor and Shut Down Process and Utility Systems.
  • 2 Monitor, maintain and optimize process parameters (Level, flow, temperature, pressure etc.) within operating requirements.
  • 3 Compare sample and testing results (API/BS &W/salinity) of process and utility fluids to optimal.
  • 4 Trouble shoot to maximize sales quality and delivery volume to identify problems.
  • 5 Maintain discharge water quality within current O &M Contractor Operations or local guidelines.
  • 6 Monitor and operate electrical/hydraulic control panels, safety and emergency shutdown devices, Fire and Gas Systems.
  • 7 Ensure accurate production reporting is submitted daily or as required by company and client.
  • 8 Witness third party calibrations when appropriate to provide verification of meter factors and volumes.
  • 9 Prove export oil meters.
  • 2) Marine/Safety
  • 1 Implementing and enforcing Management System policies and procedures in particular Isolation Standards, and PTW.
  • 2 Carry out all operations in safe and environmentally sound manner.
  • 3 Report all discharges, leaks, spills, injuries, and incidents, immediately.
  • 4 Ensure personnel understand and comply with current environmental regulations.
  • 5 Carry out Emergency Response role.
  • 3) Maintenance
  • 1 Assist maintenance operations by applying/removing isolations as required.
  • 2 Supervise operation of PTW system.
  • 3 Advise maintenance personnel on hazards of plant and equipment.
  • 4 Maintain clear and precise communications during maintenance operations.
  • 4) Manage & Supervise Effectively
  • 1 Coordinate activities and resources across teams or shift.
  • 2 Contribute to training and assessment of personnel.
  • 3 Control activities and development of subordinate personnel.
  • 4 Record and report on personnel development/appraisals and competence assessments as required.
  • 5 Efficiency improvement and pursue company goals.
  • 6 Create and maintain effective working relationships. 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Handover Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - P&ID Offshore - Safety Management - HOD Offshore - Plant Walk Through Offshore - Introduction to DCS Offshore - Stock monitoring Offshore - Communications Offshore - Permit-to-Work System

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Experience in Hydrocarbon processing operations with 1 year as CCRO and appropriate mix of operational and supervisory experience.
  • Offshore Personal Survival, Management of Major Emergencies, Medical certificates.
  • Good level of troubleshooting and operations knowledge including interpretation of P &IDs and C &E charts.
  • Extensive knowledge of offshore FPSO operations, including Production, Maintenance, Engineering and Safety.
  • Good working Knowledge of DCS and F &G systems operation.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of A2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

    • GENERAL INFORMATION

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Detalhes da vaga
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D'Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D'Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.
Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.
Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.
A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.
Requisitos
Formação Superior Completa em Administração, Economia ou Engenharia;
Necessário conhecimento em Finanças Corporativas, Valuation e Microsoft Office;
Desejável conhecimento em Fiscal e contabilidade.
Atividades
Acompanhamento de desempenho econômico-financeiro, analisando as variações entre orçado e realizado, identificando causas, estimando impactos nos resultados e apoiando a liderança com propostas de recomposição e ganho de eficiência;
Atuação na construção de cenários, previsões e análises que suportem a tomada de decisão, além de estruturar modelos financeiros para novas iniciativas, avaliar premissas e concluir de forma clara sobre a viabilidade e a sustentabilidade dos projetos.

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical rigor, product assurance and collaboration with cross‑functional manufacturing teams ensure flawless execution of in‑house production?

Would you bring the critical thinking, discipline and problem‑solving mindset needed to drive continuous improvement in fabrication, assembly and product validation processes?

Join our Quality Team

At Baker Hughes, Quality is essential to delivering safe, reliable and high-performing products. Our Product QA team ensures alignment with the Quality Management System (QMS), customer requirements and industry standards across internal manufacturing operations.

Partner with the best

As a Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba), you will ensure technical requirements are properly implemented and verified throughout fabrication, assembly and validation activities inside our Curitiba plant. You will support audits, risk assessments, first article inspections, non‑conformance management and continuous improvement initiatives to guarantee flawless execution.

As the Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba) you will be responsible for:

  • Reviewing and improving in-house product quality performance on a frequent basis.
  • Collaborating with Lean initiatives to enable process improvements and flawless execution.
  • Leading first article inspection (FAI) processes internally, ensuring product and process alignment with requirements using risk assessment tools such as FMEA.
  • Conducting product quality audits and performing routine Gemba walks to validate compliance to technical specifications.
  • Acting as a risk assessor for manufacturing processes and mitigating identified execution risks.
  • Supporting and/or leading Go/No-Go reviews and facilitating pre-production meetings.
  • Capturing, resolving and communicating operational Lessons Learned to Supply Chain and Product Delivery teams.
  • Promoting quality culture by conducting continuous improvement workshops.
  • Identifying, reviewing and addressing product non-conformances and driving strategic corrective actions.
  • Implementing and monitoring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Communicating approaches and methods for solving complex quality issues.
  • Ensuring adherence to Product Line quality directives at fabrication sites.
  • Witnessing in-house product inspections and qualification activities.
  • Registering and escalating critical observations to the appropriate levels of the organization.
  • Leading manufacturing review processes for new first articles with relevant stakeholders.
  • Acting as an enabler for implementing Non‑Conformance Management processes within internal operations.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering.
  • Have fluent English skills.
  • Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements for subsea equipment fabrication (XT, Manifolds, Tooling).
  • Have previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.
  • Have experience performing quality and product requirement audits.
  • Have knowledge in product inspection processes and technical documentation analysis.
  • Have experience using quality tools such as A3, 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, 5S and Lean Six‑Sigma.
  • Have strong leadership skills.
  • Have negotiation and influencing abilities with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Have the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and quality requirements.
  • Have a Master's degree in a Quality‑related discipline. (Desirable)
  • Have technical qualification or certification in Dimensional, Painting, Welding, NDT or Fabrication inspection. (Desirable)

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm or from 8am-5pm.
  • Location: Curitiba, PR.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Senior Specialist - QA Engineering
